oracle.name: Baxter Building
oracle.oracle_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{4}, {T}: Add four mana in any combination of colors.
{4}, {T}: Draw a card. Activate only if you control a creature with toughness 4 or greater.

oracle.name: Raft Security Officer
oracle.oracle_text: {2}, {T}: Tap target creature. This ability costs {1} less to activate if it targets a creature with power 3 or less.

Baxter Building: Ordinary untapped land play; no mana casting cost. Land color identity colorless does not restrict its colored production.
Tap for one colorless immediately, independent of toughness witness.

Pay4 generic plus tap for exactly4 mana in ANY combination of WUBRG, including repetitions/splits, excluding colorless. Must seed4 before ability resolves; cannot use its own future output or first tap it forC and then tap it again for the filter.

Pay4 generic plus tap for one draw using stack; starts only if controller CURRENTLY controls effective creature with toughness>=4, including animated self or a tapped creature, counters/CDA/lords/current control. Damage marked does not reduce toughness.

Once begun legally, do not recheck witness during mana-payment/cost changes or at resolution. Draw goes to captured activating controller despite source/witness removal, blink, control change or suppression. First two modes are mana abilities, draw is not.
Raft Security Officer: Pay1W for Human Soldier1/3. Ordinary creature tap-cost summoning sickness/haste.

Pay2 generic plus tap to target any legal creature, including self, own/opposing, already tapped, any current power. On resolution tap surviving legal exact target; never untap or require target untapped.
Mandatory1 generic reduction if chosen creature has current effective power<=3 at cost-lock time; negative/zero count,4 does not. This changes cost, not target legality.
Determine/lock discount after choosing target, before mana abilities and tap/cost events. Subsequent power change cannot demand refund/top-up, prevent effect or alter frozen total.

Source removal/control/abilities changes after activation do not cancel captured packet; target leave-and-return/new incarnation is illegal. Usual hexproof/protection and ward targeting apply. Self-target ability normally costs1 and tap occurs as cost before redundant tap effect.

authoritative_rules.summary: Baxter guard is only an activation starting restriction; no other player acts in the activation process and the toughness condition is not checked again afterward.

Targets precede legality/total-cost determination; total locks before mana abilities and payments. Tap cost creature sickness applies to Raft or animated Baxter.
